class_id: a tool picks its 'latest' record by sorting names, while the repo names records under two schemes, so a correctly linked chain is read from the wrong end
feature: any tool that selects the newest artefact in a directory by lexical file-name order (drizzle-kit snapshot selection, migration runners, sorted release folders) in a repository where names follow more than one prefix scheme (index `00NN_` and timestamp `YYYYMMDDhhmmss_`)
symptom: the lineage recorded INSIDE the artefacts (id / prevId) is a perfect straight chain and every chain check passes, but the tool never reads the lineage: it takes the last file by name sort. Once one scheme sorts entirely before the other (`0` < `2`), every artefact written under the lower-sorting scheme after the switch is invisible to selection, and the tool silently uses a stale base. Output generated from that base re-creates everything the invisible artefacts added. The generated output looks non-destructive (CREATE / ADD only), so a destructive-DDL review passes it; it fails only at apply time on a database that already has those objects. The generic test is: does the element the tool will SELECT (last by its own sort) equal the element the lineage calls the head?
first_seen: 2026-09-26 — IPODhan `web/drizzle/migrations/meta/` (#886). idx 33-49 are timestamp-named (`20260906090638_` .. `20260918211158_`); idx 50-65 were hand-named `0050_` .. `0065_`. The prevId chain was continuous (`20260918211158` d0938915 -> `0050` c1009d2e -> ... -> `0065` 9472c00a) and check-migration-snapshot-chain passed, but drizzle-kit 0.31.7 prepareOutFolder sorts readdir and takes the last file, `20260918211158_snapshot.json`. A dry `drizzle-kit generate --prefix=timestamp` with no schema change emitted an 8,113-byte migration: 4 CREATE TYPE, 5 CREATE TABLE, 14 ADD COLUMN, 9 ADD CONSTRAINT, 8 CREATE INDEX, 0 DROP — all objects 0050..0065 already created, parent prevId d0938915.
fix_prs: #886 fix (branch fix/886-snapshot-chain): a bridge snapshot `20260926161247_snapshot.json`, a byte copy of `0065_snapshot.json` with only `id` (new uuid 243aeefd) and `prevId` (= 0065's id 9472c00a) changed, so the head sorts last. No applied migration's SQL, tag or journal entry changed (drizzle-orm's migrator keys on journal `when` + SQL hash, and the journal lint binds each tag to `<prefix>_snapshot.json`, so renaming 0050..0065 would have meant 16 journal edits). After: the same dry generate prints 'No schema changes, nothing to migrate'.
detection_check: scripts/ci/check-migration-snapshot-chain.mjs rule `head-sorts-last` (CI job in pr-gate.yml): FAILS when the chain head is not the last `*_snapshot.json` by name sort, naming both files. Red on main before the bridge (head 0065_snapshot.json vs selected 20260918211158_snapshot.json), green after; self-tests replay the real ids and a recurrence case (an index-named `0066_` added after the bridge).
